 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Paint an 8-colored horizontal stripe immediately above the object."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    # The background is the most frequent color; the marker is another full row.
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    marker_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    marker_color = grid[marker_rows[0]][0] if marker_rows else None
    obj_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg and v != marker_color for v in row)]
    if obj_rows:
        top = min(obj_rows)
        if top > 0:
            out[top - 1] = [8] * len(grid[0])
    return out
"
